question: An electric generator and an electric motor work in the principle of:

options.text: Fleming’s left and right-hand rule, respectively
Fleming’s right and left-hand rule, respectively

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fleming’s right and left-hand rule, respectively**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electric generators operate on the principle of Fleming’s right-hand rule, which is used to predict the direction of induced current when a conductor moves in a magnetic field.
 
• Electric motors work based on Fleming’s left-hand rule, which helps in determining the direction of force experienced by a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.
 
• The correct answer is option 4: Fleming’s right and left-hand rule, respectively, for generators and motors.
 
• These rules are essential for understanding the operation of many electromagnetic devices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fleming’s Left and Right-Hand Rules are named after British engineer and physicist John Ambrose Fleming, who contributed significantly to the development of modern electronics and electrical engineering.
 
• These rules provide a simple and effective way to remember the direction of force, magnetic field, and current in electrical systems.
